whatsapp.title: WhatsApp integration
whatsapp.intro: Connect your WhatsApp Business number through Meta. Secrets are stored encrypted and only shown masked.
whatsapp.idHelp: Meta App Dashboard → WhatsApp → API Setup.
whatsapp.accessTokenHelp: A permanent System User token with whatsapp_business_messaging.
whatsapp.appSecretHelp: App settings → Basic. Used to verify that webhook calls really come from Meta.
whatsapp.keepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the saved value
whatsapp.verifyTokenHelp: Any secret string (8–128 characters, no spaces). Meta sends it back when you verify the webhook.
whatsapp.verifyTokenPlaceholder: Type a token or generate one
whatsapp.tokenGenerated: New token generated. Save, then paste it into Meta.
whatsapp.publicBaseUrlHelp: How Meta reaches the Rapidos API from the internet, e.g. your ngrok HTTPS address. Leave blank to use {default}.
whatsapp.callbackUrlHelp: The path {path} is fixed; only the base URL changes.
whatsapp.notPublic: Meta only accepts a public HTTPS URL. For local testing, start a tunnel (e.g. ngrok http 8080) and paste its https:// address above.
whatsapp.steps.title: Connect the webhook in Meta
whatsapp.steps.1: Save this form with your verify token and public base URL.
whatsapp.steps.2: In the Meta App Dashboard, open WhatsApp → Configuration and click Edit under Webhook.
whatsapp.steps.3: Paste the Callback URL and the Verify token shown here, then click Verify and save.
whatsapp.steps.5: Use "Test webhook" below to confirm the API accepts the saved token.
whatsapp.webhookOk: Webhook verified: the API accepts the saved verify token.
whatsapp.webhookPublicFail: The API accepts the token, but the public URL did not answer correctly ({status}). Check that your tunnel is running and points to port 8080.
whatsapp.webhookBackendFail: The API rejected the saved verify token ({status}).
whatsapp.error.invalid_public_base_url: Enter a valid http(s) base URL without query string, e.g. https://abc.ngrok-free.app.
whatsapp.error.invalid_verify_token: The verify token must be 8–128 characters with no spaces.
whatsapp.error.verify_token_in_use: This verify token is already used by another company. Generate a new one.
whatsapp.error.phone_number_id_in_use: This phone number ID is already connected to another company.
whatsapp.error.invalid_whatsappPhoneNumb: The phone number ID should contain digits only.
whatsapp.error.invalid_whatsappBusinessA: The business account ID should contain digits only.
whatsapp.error.invalid_primary_color: The primary color must be a six-digit hex color.
whatsapp.connection_incomplete: Enter and save the display number, phone number ID, business account ID and access token first.
whatsapp.connection_complete: Saved WhatsApp connection settings are complete.
whatsapp.backend_unreachable: Unable to reach the bot backend. Check that the API container is running.
